svg.title: Lem
svg.desc: A tall hooded coat stands in a cut field and holds one long line in both hands. One small red eye glows in its hood and blinks. Strands hang from the line to four smaller hooded figures, each with a small red eye in its hood, and to the word Lem, set in pixel letters with a block cursor. A small glow starts in the coat's hands and runs down the strands of the four figures, the two nearest first; each figure's eye lights as the glow reaches it, then fades. The line, the word and its strands stay still. By day a low sun sends haze and soft rays over the field; at night stars blink and pale bands of light drift across the sky.
